paragraphs.text: Meloku (MEHL-oh-koo; Japanese: メロク; rōmaji : Meroku ) was a soratami ambassador to the human world at daimyo Konda 's court in Eiganjo , and especially to the human students of the arcane at the Minamo School on Kamigawa .

The wizard Meloku assisted Konda with the ritual of ripping That Which Was Taken from the spirit world, the crime that started the Kami War . It is hinted that Meloku could have been the one who suggested this to Konda to start the long-term plan of the soratami that should have ended with them taking over the whole of Kamigawa.
Sometime before the Kami War, he found a dragon egg and brought it into his palace. The egg was later stolen by the akki Kiki-Jiki , who was sent there by Keiga , the dragon to whom the egg belonged.
